creativeDirection: Daylight location photography of a real outdoor lido where the strongest portrait is staged intact and the graphic covers are translated into built surfaces and props rather than reproduced as images.
scene: An empty urban outdoor swimming pool deck beside a drained pool, dominated by a dark winged angel statue on a plinth near the deep end, with painted lane markings, concrete steps, and a few scattered poolside objects in a clean, physically plausible public-lido setting.

elements.element: two real candle flames in the near foreground beside the cast woman's face, adding blue-versus-amber colour contrast
a crucifix necklace hanging visibly at the neckline of the cast woman's pool robe or swimsuit styling
the woman from the cover appears recognisably, wearing the white swim cap decorated with pale yellow flowers and leaves, with stylized eyeliner and red lipstick
a black winged angel statue on a stone plinth rises beside the pool against a vivid red-painted wall or red sky glow
a cigarette rests between the cast woman's raised fingers near her face
bleached concrete pool steps and stark monochrome striping on the deck echo the graphic severity of the seated-on-steps photograph
a simple tall lifeguard stool stands empty near the pool, borrowing the isolated stool silhouette
the pool floor and deck furniture use coral, teal, blue, yellow, and purple geometric accents, and curved drainage lines subtly suggest the stylized nose motif

coverSummaries.description: A grainy, high-contrast close-up photograph in neon-like colours shows part of a person’s face and hand in blue tones, with the hand raised near the mouth. Two glowing yellow-orange candle flames appear in the foreground, one large on the left edge and one smaller on the right. The background is dark and abstracted by the heavy colour treatment.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: glowing candle flames beside a blue-tinted face
coverSummaries.medium: colour photograph with heavy posterized/grainy treatment
coverSummaries.people: one person in extreme close-up with hand near face

coverSummaries.description: A close cropped colour photograph of a bare male torso and upper arm. A dark crucifix necklace hangs over the chest, and a colourful tattoo of a rose with ribbon is visible on the upper arm. The skin-toned background is simply the body filling the frame.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: crucifix necklace on a bare chest
coverSummaries.people: one shirtless man shown from neck to upper torso

coverSummaries.description: A close-up colour photograph of a woman’s face and shoulders. She wears a white swim cap decorated with a ring of pale yellow daisy-like flowers and green leaves. Her makeup is stylized with dark eyeliner and red lipstick. The softly blurred background suggests an indoor swimming pool in cool blue and purple tones.
coverSummaries.people: one woman in close portrait wearing a floral swim cap

coverSummaries.description: A dramatic image of a dark winged angel statue centered against a vivid red sky. The statue raises one arm holding a wreath-like object and extends the other holding a branch. At the bottom, dark silhouettes of horse figures and chariot elements frame the base of the statue.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: black winged angel statue against a red sky

coverSummaries.description: A close portrait photograph of a man with dark hair against a soft pink background. He faces forward with one hand raised, holding a cigarette between his fingers. He wears layered clothing in dark and blue tones.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: man holding a cigarette near his face
coverSummaries.people: one man in close portrait holding a cigarette

coverSummaries.description: A stark black-and-white, high-contrast photograph shows a tattooed person seated on outdoor steps with head bowed and arms folded over their knees. The figure wears a sleeveless top, striped socks, and dark shoes. The composition is gritty and centered, with the steps and pavement forming the background.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: seated tattooed person with head bowed on steps
coverSummaries.medium: black-and-white photograph with high-contrast graphic treatment
coverSummaries.people: one person seated with head down and tattooed arms

coverSummaries.description: A black-and-white studio photograph of a tattooed man sitting on a tall stool against a plain white background. He wears a cowboy hat, dark sunglasses, a fitted white T-shirt, and white briefs, with bare legs and feet visible. His head tilts downward and his hands rest loosely between his knees.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: tattooed man in cowboy hat seated on a stool
coverSummaries.people: one man seated on a stool wearing a cowboy hat and sunglasses

coverSummaries.description: A flat graphic illustration on a coral-orange background filled with thin horizontal black lines. In the center, the lines curve downward to form a stylized nose shape. Around the lower sides of the nose are simple geometric shapes: a blue quadrilateral, a teal polygon, a yellow hexagon, and a purple triangle, each with dotted fill and black shadowing.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: stylized nose formed by curved horizontal lines

prompt: A real outdoor public lido photographed from a low angle near pool-deck level, looking across the edge of a drained swimming pool toward a dark winged angel statue on a plinth near the deep end; the primary subject is the woman from reference image 3 staged recognisably in the foreground off-centre, close to camera, wearing her white swim cap decorated with pale yellow flowers and green leaves, with the same stylized eyeliner and red lipstick, facing the camera with a calm direct presence. Two real candle flames from reference image 1 burn in the near foreground beside her face, one larger near the left edge and one smaller to the right; a crucifix necklace from reference image 2 is visible at her neckline; she holds a cigarette near her face in the manner of reference image 5. Behind her, the black winged angel statue from reference image 4 rises over the pool deck, with horse-and-chariot hints contained in the plinth sculpture. The drained pool has stark concrete steps and severe black-and-white striping echoing reference image 6, and an empty tall lifeguard stool quietly echoes reference image 7. Reference image 8 is translated into the place through curved drainage lines and small geometric poolside accents in coral, teal, blue, yellow, and purple on deck furniture and pool markings, with no printed graphics or posters. Daylight location photography, crisp realistic detail, no collage, no painted sleeve reproductions. Compose with the woman large in the lower left or centre-left foreground and the angel statue farther back to the right, leaving open deck and pool basin visible; bright overcast daylight with clean even exposure and saturated colour, no haze, no rain, no lush foliage. Palette of coral, pool blue, white, black, red, and pale yellow; mood ceremonial, uncanny, and poised. Reference map for people (the album images are attached in this numbered order): reference image 3 shows one woman in close portrait wearing a floral swim cap. Copy each of these faces directly from that numbered reference image - same face, bone structure, hair, expression, and styling - rather than drawing a new person from the description. Nobody from reference images 1, 2, 5, 6, 7 appears in the picture: use those images only for colour, setting, and objects, and add no figures, faces, or silhouettes from them. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails, and do not get round that by copying a sleeve flat onto a mural, banner, poster, billboard, tapestry, wall panel, screen, or floor graphic; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling, and their apparent age: every person is shown as the adult they are on the sleeve, never younger, smoothed, or more boyish or girlish. Keep each reference person in the pose, expression, and gaze the sleeve shows, and keep every identifiable face sharp, lit, unobscured, and in focus: no motion blur, long-exposure smearing, steam, fog, shadow, crowding, or shallow depth of field over a reference person's face. Expose the image brightly and cleanly: open, readable shadows and clear colour, with no murky underexposure, crushed blacks, heavy film grain, digital noise, or dust-and-scratches texture. Add no incidental plants: no flowers, potted plants, planters, climbing vines, ivy, hanging foliage, hedges, lawns, flower beds, or greenery framing the edges or carpeting the floor, unless the description above explicitly asks for that plant as part of a source motif or the year treatment. Dress the scene with the materials of the place itself - stone, metal, concrete, wood, fabric, glass, water, equipment - rather than vegetation. Everyone in the picture is photographed in the same place, at the same moment, under the same light as the rest of the scene, in full colour and with the same lens and grain: do not carry over a sleeve's own backdrop, studio lighting, backlit flare, monochrome, colour cast, or print texture onto the person. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
